identification: Sterling silver helmet-form cream jug on a stepped square foot, high loop handle, plain body, H 14 cm. Georgian-revival (Edwardian-style) form, so likely c.1900-1915 rather than a genuine 1790s piece. Hallmarks on the body next to the handle: four punches in a row (a small crescent-like first mark, a plain small punch, lion passant in a shield, and a single date-letter punch that looks like C). Maker and assay office not legible.
